# SensoryGatedSpikingLoop

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A closed-loop spiking architecture where sensory spikes gate or modulate CPG activity to adjust locomotion in real time. Highlights the integration of sensing and actuation in TCC/iNEST, enabling reactive and robust behavior in dynamic environments.
